text: Our paper `Intercultural Communication Environment to Support Agriculture Mediated by Youths in Developing Countries,` has received the Best-Paper Award of the Human Interface Society in 2018.
Ms.Motozawa has been awarded the Graduate School Research Excellence Award in 2021.

Mr.Oi's paper `Service Clustering with Heterogeneous Networks` has received The Young Scientist Incentive Award from the Technical Committee on Services Computing, The Institute of Electronics, Information and Communication Engineers in 2023.
Mr.Nishimura, Ms.Motozawa, Mr.Kitagawa, and Mr.Yamamoto have been awarded the Graduate School Research Encouragement Award in 2024.

Mr.Matsumoto's paper `API recommendation for service composition using large-scale language models` has received The Young Scientist Incentive Award from the Technical Committee on Services Computing, The Institute of Electronics, Information and Communication Engineers in 2025.
